summary: Move publication examples, evaluations and integration workloads to st apply while retaining the legacy aliases during caller rollout

replay.detail: Publication still uses the same resolved intent and subject-token fences; no replay change.

schema.detail: No database or declaration schema change.

compatibility.detail: Both legacy publication commands remain available with their existing stderr notices. Migrated seat callers explicitly pass --no-gate-check; unified apply adds published_missions to successful seat receipts.

downtime.detail: No service restart or interruption is required by these caller changes.

manual.detail: No required upgrade step. External callers can replace missions publish FILE with apply FILE using the same options, and agents apply FILE with apply FILE --no-gate-check.

recovery.detail: No durable-state mutation or new recovery procedure.
